welcome.bubble: Hi, I'm Prana. Once I know you, I'll take your shape.
welcome.returning: New here or coming back? Same button — Google signs you up the first time and logs you in after that.
title: Feel more settled,
one small practice
at a time.
welcome.note: Free to use · A wellbeing companion, not a substitute for professional care

quizLines: Answer for how you usually are, not just today.
Halfway there. I'm starting to take shape!

minutes.q: How much time do you have most days?

wake.q: When do you usually wake up?

doshaBlurbs.vata: Quick, creative and light on your feet. When out of balance, you may run on worry or restlessness.
doshaBlurbs.pitta: Sharp, focused and driven. When out of balance, you may run hot — impatient or easily irritated.
doshaBlurbs.kapha: Steady, calm and caring. When out of balance, you may feel heavy, slow or low.
doshaBlurbs.tridosha: A rare, even balance of all three. Prana will follow how each day feels.

moods.label: Anxious
moods.say: Anxious — thank you for telling me. We'll go gentle and grounding today.

moods.label: Overthinking
moods.say: A busy mind. I'll pick things that give it one simple focus.

moods.label: Irritable
moods.say: Feeling heated. Let's cool and soften things today.

moods.label: Stressed
moods.say: Lots on your plate. We'll keep today short and steady.

moods.label: Low
moods.say: A low day is okay. Let's add a little warmth and lift.

moods.label: Sluggish
moods.say: Heavy and slow — let's wake the body up gently.

okay.label: Feeling okay today
okay.say: Glad you're okay! We'll keep you nicely balanced.

checkinAsk: How are you feeling today? Pick the one that fits best.
todayLines: Here are your three for today. Take them one at a time.
Lovely — one done. Take the next one whenever you're ready.
Two done! Just one more and today is complete.
All three done. That's a calm, kind day.
noMatch: Nothing in this part fits your diet yet. Prana is learning more practices.

support.title: Talk to someone
support.body: If things feel heavy or you need to talk, a trained counsellor can help — free and confidential.

lines.name: Tele-MANAS
lines.what: India's national mental health helpline · free, 24×7

hum.setup: Let's hum together. First, how settled do you feel right now?
hum.micWhy: I listen to how long and how steadily you hum — the sound is measured on your phone and never recorded or sent. Without the mic, you can still practise with a simple timer.
hum.noiseAsk: Stay quiet for 3 seconds so I can tell your hum apart from the room.
hum.noisy: It's a bit too noisy here for me to listen well.
hum.ready: Breathe in slowly through your nose, then hum softly.
hum.timerHint: Hold the button while you hum, let go to breathe in.
hum.endEarly: You've done fewer than 2 rounds, so this session won't be saved. End anyway?
hum.privacy: Your voice was analysed on this device only. Only these numbers are saved.

after.better: You feel {n} more settled than before. I'll remember this works for you.
after.same: About the same as before — that's okay. Some days are like that.
after.worse: A little less settled. Thank you for being honest — that helps me learn what suits you.
